description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about refunds after a cancellation or long delay.

files.description: A Slack thread in #policy-updates between Skyway staff about refunds after a cancellation or long delay, dated between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-01: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "From December 1 a 2-hour departure delay is enough for a refund if they don't fly."; "delayed 2 hours or more"; "This applies to every request handled from December 1, whatever the date of the flight.". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
